shortDescription: Generate a new private key and certificate signed by the root certificate

options.name: acme
options.description: ACME directory url to be used for requesting certificates via the ACME protocol. Use this parameter to define an ACME server other than the Step CA. If this flag is absent and an ACME provisioner has been selected then the I(ca_url) parameter must be defined.

options.name: ca_config
options.description: The path to the certificate authority configuration file on the host.

options.name: ca_url
options.description: URI of the targeted Step Certificate Authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: contact
options.description: The email-address used for contact as part of the ACME protocol. These contacts may be used to warn of certificate expiration or other certificate lifetime events. Must be a list

options.name: crt_file
options.description: File to write the certificate (PEM format)

options.name: curve
options.description: The elliptic curve to use for EC and OKP key types. Corresponds to the "crv" JWK parameter. Valid curves are defined in JWA [RFC7518]. If unset, default is P-256 for EC keys and Ed25519 for OKP keys.

options.name: force
options.description: Force the overwrite of files without asking.

options.name: http_listen
options.description: Use a non-standard http address, behind a reverse proxy or load balancer, for serving ACME challenges. The default address is :80, which requires super user (sudo) privileges. This flag must be used in conjunction with the I(standalone) param.

options.name: k8ssa_token_path
options.description: Configure the file from which to read the kubernetes service account token.

options.name: key_file
options.description: File to write the private key (PEM format)

options.name: kty
options.description: The kty to build the certificate upon. If unset, default is EC. I(kty) is a case-sensitive string.

options.name: name
options.description: The Common Name, DNS Name, or IP address that will be set as the Subject Common Name for the certificate. If no Subject Alternative Names (SANs) are configured (via the san parameter) then the subject will be set as the only SAN.

options.name: not_after
options.description: The time/duration when the certificate validity period ends. If a time is used it is expected to be in RFC 3339 format. If a duration is used, it is a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: not_before
options.description: The time/duration when the certificate validity period starts. If a time is used it is expected to be in RFC 3339 format. If a duration is used, it is a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: offline
options.description: Don't contact the CA. Offline mode uses the configuration, certificates, and keys created with step ca init, but can accept a different configuration file using the I(ca_config) flag.

options.name: provisioner
options.description: The provisioner name to use.

options.name: provisioner_password_file
options.description: The path to the file containing the password to decrypt the one-time token generating key.

options.name: root
options.description: The path to the PEM file used as the root certificate authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: san
options.description: Add dns/ip/email/uri Subject Alternative Name(s) (SANs) that should be authorized. The I(san) parameter and the I(token) parameter are mutually exclusive. Must be a list.

options.name: set
options.description: The key=value pair with template data variables to send to the CA. Must be a list.

options.name: set_file
options.description: The path of a JSON file with the template data to send to the CA.

options.name: size
options.description: The size (in bits) of the key for RSA and oct key types. RSA keys require a minimum key size of 2048 bits. If unset, default is 2048 bits for RSA keys and 128 bits for oct keys.

options.name: standalone
options.description: Get a certificate using the ACME protocol and standalone mode for validation. Standalone is a mode in which the step process will run a server that will will respond to ACME challenge validation requests. Standalone is the default mode for serving challenge validation requests.

options.name: step_cli_executable
options.description: Name (or absolute path) of the C(step-cli) executable to use

options.name: token
options.description: The one-time token used to authenticate with the CA in order to create the certificate.

options.name: webroot
options.description: Specify a path to use as a 'web root' for validation in the ACME protocol. Webroot is a mode in which the step process will write a challenge file to a location being served by an existing fileserver in order to respond to ACME challenge validation requests.

options.name: x5c_cert
options.description: Certificate (chain) in PEM format to store in the 'x5c' header of a JWT.

options.name: x5c_key
options.description: Private key path, used to sign a JWT, corresponding to the certificate that will be stored in the 'x5c' header.
